verdict.rationale: Function calling lets the agent's LLM decide to invoke defined functions during a conversation (deepgram-docs-2, deepgram-docs-20), which is the closest analog to event-triggered automation, but this is model-driven action selection rather than user-defined declarative rules that fire on specific events. There's no documented rule-engine, webhook-on-event, or conditional trigger system beyond LLM function calling and mid-call message injection (deepgram-docs-11). missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger definition syntax, event-based (non-LLM) automation, and evidence of deterministic 'if event X then action Y' configuration.
